messages:
kevin: Starting a 30m post-freeze cooldown window. Canary traffic on, running health checks. If anything breaches, abort and roll back. tagging @sre-oncall @maria

deploy-bot: Deploy freeze lifted by kevin at 2024-05-12T21:13:09Z
Status: CANARY → running 50rps
Pinned: v20240512-abc123
Unpin: scheduled in 30m
Logs: https://deploys/reports/1703456789

maria: smoke run started on staging-cluster-3. running smoke script now: `./smoke.sh --targets=canary`

sre-oncall: Watching latency / errors / cpu. I set alert thresholds: +10% latency, +1% errors over a 10m window. Will call abort if any sustained breach.

deploy-bot: Canary metrics @ t+5m: latency +3%, errors +0.2%, cpu +8% — within thresholds.

sam: Observed a minor spike in DB connections at t+8m, investigating connection-pool behaviour.

maria: Rolling a quick pgbouncer bump on canary nodes: `pgbouncer max_client_conn=500` (applied).

sre-oncall: Connections stabilized after change. No user-facing errors observed. :thumbsup:

product-ops: FYI traffic-shift plan: gradual ramp 5% -> 20% -> 50% -> 100%. Will do first step after green.

kevin: Agree. We'll do 3-step ramp: 5% for 6m, to 20% for 12m, then 50% and reassess. Abort if errors >0.5% absolute.

deploy-bot: Traffic shifted to 5% at t+12m. Canary variant: v20240512-abc123.

sam: Monitoring logs — flagged a warning in text-generation pipeline about KV-cache warmup at t+14m. Not dropping requests but latency microspike.

maria: Disable prefetch on canary to reduce cache regen pressure; patch rolled in (will monitor).

deploy-bot: Traffic ramped to 20% at t+18m. Metrics: latency +4%, errors +0.25%, cpu +9% — still inside abort thresholds.

kevin: Initiating final unpin check. Hold 10m for stability, then unpin if green.

maria: Running final evals — perf p95 and quality sampling (10 golden prompts). No regressions / hallucination spikes observed.

deploy-bot: Unpinning v20240512-abc123 scheduled at t+30m. Action queued by kevin.

sre-oncall: Reminder: fast rollback lane exists. Reapply pin with `/run rollback --tag v20240512-abc123` if anything degrades post-unpin. Keep tracing hooks open.

kevin: Thanks team. I'll be monitoring for the next 45m. Ping me immediately to abort. :rocket:
